description: Source code for the BrowserContext class in Playwright, managing browser context lifecycle, pages, cookies, permissions, storage, and related functionalities.

classes.name: BrowserContext
classes.description: Abstract class managing browser context lifecycle, pages, cookies, permissions, storage, and event handling in Playwright.

methods.name: _initialize
methods.description: Initializes debugging, inspector, and permissions for the browser context.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the browser context, flushing recordings, tracing, and cleaning up resources.

methods.name: newPage
methods.description: Creates a new page within the browser context.

methods.name: storageState
methods.description: Collects and returns the storage state including cookies, localStorage, and IndexedDB.

methods.name: setStorageState
methods.description: Sets the storage state (cookies, localStorage, IndexedDB) for the context.

methods.name: extendInjectedScript
methods.description: Extends the injected script in all frames and pages.

methods.name: safeNonStallingEvaluateInAllFrames
methods.description: Evaluates a script in all frames safely without stalling.

methods.name: harStart
methods.description: Starts HAR recording for the context.

methods.name: addRouteInFlight
methods.description: Adds a network route to the in-flight set.

methods.name: removeRouteInFlight
methods.description: Removes a network route from the in-flight set.

methods.name: notifyRoutesInFlightAboutRemovedHandler
methods.description: Notifies all in-flight routes about a removed handler.
